authorship: AI-authored analytical review; not human verified.

source_identity.title: Adversarial Machine Learning: A Taxonomy and Terminology of Attacks and Mitigations

scope: All 22 canonical records: 16 taxonomy definitions and six cross-cutting threat-model, mitigation, benchmark or evaluation propositions from Sections 2.1–4.2.5.
excluded_material: Unrepresented examples, references and explanatory repetition were not promoted into new EXTREQ records.
No attack definition was treated as an independent governance duty.
No Fidelity Class relationships, Incident findings or new taxonomy categories were created.
unresolved_issues: The report expressly describes evolving attacks and mitigations, trade-offs and context-dependent risk; no universal control claim was inferred.
AI review is not human verification; assurance is limited to the represented extraction scope.
